The new online-only booking system is inefficient and dangerous. You're required to request medication, and its taken 4 DAYS to get a GP to approve it. Repeat prescriptions require you to complete a form every time. If you'd like to book a GP, you can only access the *digital form* during opening times. One off medication? You won't be informed if it's ready, just have to assume and waste your time going. I'm sorry, but who the hell thought this was a good idea? Diabolical service.

----------
Avoid certain doctors.

My pregnant wife was told in her first trimester to "toughen up".

I requested a call about an update on test results I'd received on the Patient Access App, with the same GP saying "this better not be about the results we have already spoken about" — highlighting her cluelessness about the update.

The other GPs are marvelous, as are the reception staff. Shame that they're dragged down because one of them has 0 bedside manner or
